issue_context.title: Energy Configuration is broken after adding entity with current price
issue_context.body:
### The problem

After having selected an entity with current price for Energy, the Energy configuration page breaks and is not accessible anymore. Also static price does not calculate, but does not break the configuration page.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58339726/132405083-7c5a3bb0-f4b3-43be-914e-74071151785e.png)


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.9.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Energy

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/08/04/home-energy-management/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt

Source: components/energy/validate.py:227
Integration: Home Assistant WebSocket API (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 11:32:37 AM (1 occurrences)

[1719007096] Error handling message: Unknown error

    hass.data[DOMAIN]["cost_sensors"][flow["stat_energy_from"]],
KeyError: 'sensor.yearly_energy_offpeak'
```
